sc: Baby not breathing after drying and stimulation → Bag-and-mask ventilation within the golden minute
HR 50 after 30 s of effective ventilation → Chest compressions 3 : 1
Sudden deterioration on bag ventilation, one side silent → Pneumothorax: needle decompression
f: Dry, keep warm, clear airway only if blocked, rub back · not breathing or HR < 100 → ventilate by 60 seconds
Most important step: effective ventilation · start in room air (21%) at term · chest not rising: reposition, check seal, ↑ pressure, airway device
HR < 60 after 30 s of good ventilation · two-thumb technique, 3 : 1 with ventilation · switch to 100% oxygen
Adrenaline 10–30 µg/kg IV via umbilical vein if HR < 60 despite compressions · volume: saline or O-neg blood 10 ml/kg
Heart rate, breathing, tone, reflex, colour · at 1 and 5 min · do not wait for the score to start resuscitation
Delayed cord clamping ≥ 60 s · SpO2 85–95% at 10 min · no HR after 20 min: consider stopping
trap: Meconium: no routine tracheal suction; non-vigorous baby → ventilate · diaphragmatic hernia: intubate, no bag-mask · SpO2 70% at 3 min is normal
